title: Manual Material Handling and Lifting
osha_standards: OSH Act Section 5(a)(1) General Duty Clause
summary: Manual Material Handling and Lifting matters because poor manual handling technique is one of the leading causes of lost-time injury in our industry.
talking_points: Assess the load before lifting (TILE: Task, Individual, Load, Environment).
Use mechanical aids or team lifts for heavy/awkward items.
Plan the route and clear obstructions first.
Never lift beyond your safe capability.
Never twist while carrying a load.
Keep loads close to the body.
If something goes wrong: stop lifting immediately if you feel strain or pain; put the load down safely; seek first aid.
site_hazards_to_check: Heavy or awkward loads (compressors, plant, cylinders)
discussion_questions: What are the main hazards of Manual Material Handling and Lifting on our jobs, and which of today's controls matters most on this site?
